title: The Primal Diet
author: Aajonus Vonderplanitz
description: Aajonus Vonderplanitz presents the ideas associated with his Primal Diet and its emphasis on raw foods. The work is an account of the author's dietary philosophy and health claims, rather than a personalised nutritional recommendation.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
